limits: No ranking or checkpoint reselection from final; all four artifacts were frozen before final evaluation.
Gate lists are eligibility for a fixed performance comparison, not selection of a new quality winner.
Local length-filtered Chinese reading-comprehension subset; not official hidden-test or universal capability.
A single training seed and finite final set; no statistical significance claim.
Merged BF16 weights can change answers from live FP32 LoRA due to rounding; use these standalone scores for deployment.
Parameter reduction is structural; actual speed/memory must be measured independently.

settings.eos_policy: ignore EOS; exactly 32 output tokens for timing only
settings.allocator_policy: gc + empty_cache + synchronize + reset peaks before each measured repeat
settings.first_token_definition: Synchronized prefill plus first greedy selection; excludes tokenizer, loading and CPU transfer.
settings.decode_definition: Next 31 tokens with KV cache; Python loop, launches, growing masks and final synchronization included.
settings.precision_scope: All four checkpoints are pure BF16 without live LoRA modules; no autocast.
settings.telemetry_policy: nvidia-smi and Windows power before/after each length, outside timed sections; not continuous sampling

limitations: Single machine and GPU, two independent process rounds; synthetic repeated Chinese token fixture.
No live LoRA; merged BF16 checkpoints only. 512 input plus 32 output is a timing workload, not the 512-token QA protocol.
TTFT excludes tokenization, disk loading and CPU output transfer; later-token rate includes Python/control overhead.
Allocator allocated/reserved are not whole-device memory. Disk weight bytes include safetensors headers.
Original snapshot and save_pretrained exports may serialize tied weights differently; disk-byte savings must not be attributed entirely to pruning.
Telemetry is sampled outside timing, not continuous; unavailable fields remain unavailable. No automatic power-setting changes.
Nonoverlapping ranges in both sessions are a conservative descriptive condition, not statistical significance or guaranteed deployment speed.
Quality acceptance is a separate prerequisite enforced by the experiment orchestrator, not inferred from speed.
